pages.text: A frozen wound in the Nether: rimestone, spikes of $(l)Rime Ice$() rising from the floor and hanging from the ceiling, and $(item)Rime Crystals$(). Skeletons and wraiths roam here.
pages.title: Gouffre de givre

pages.text: $(l)The only water of the Nether.$() Rime Ice never melts by itself; placed against heat (lava, fire, magma block, lit campfire) it slowly melts into a $(l)water source$().
